summary: Iteration 11 — Full-stack validation of (a) numeric-id search (/api/social/search-by-id/{id}), (b) follow/unfollow + follow-status + following/followers lists with idempotent upsert, (c) friends-active presence endpoint, (d) mark-join fanout regression, (e) /api/auth/firebase/status white-label helper, (f) Dashboard SearchBar + modal + toggle-follow-btn, (g) FriendsActiveStrip (empty placeholder path), (h) Popular tab 12 clickable room cards navigating to RoomView, (i) RoomView regression (top-rankings-btn + events-room-btn still rendered), (j) WebSocket /api/ws/audio regression. Backend: 12/12 pytest pass in 2.25s. Frontend: all required data-testids visible and interactive flows work end-to-end with Melvin_Live/test123.

issues: Room banner still contains user-set text '500 Internal Server Error' (owner-authored content, not an API error). Same cosmetic issue already flagged in iteration 10 — not introduced here.
Mixed 404s for /api/uploads/avatar_*.jpeg are logged in console (preexisting missing avatar files on disk). Cosmetic only — fallback image renders.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/friends.py search_by_numeric_id: does exact match on `numeric_id`. No index on db.users.numeric_id is enforced in code — for scale, add a unique index (Mongo) to guarantee lookup speed and prevent collisions on registration.

routes/friends.py notify_followers_of_room_entry: iterates follower rows sequentially and awaits create_notification one-by-one. For users with many followers this serializes. Consider asyncio.gather for fanout (still with 60s dedupe guard).

routes/friends.py /social/following and /social/followers: pass limit as a query param but default of 100 is also the to_list bound for both the follows collection AND the users lookup. If a user follows >100 accounts, follower/following lists silently truncate. Either raise the default or paginate.
routes/friends.py friends-active: no index hint on seats.user_id + target_ids filter. Fine for current scale but flag for future.

Frontend Dashboard.js now 600+ lines with SearchBar, FriendsActiveStrip, Popular tab, auto-refresh timer, modals — consider splitting Popular tab rendering into its own component for readability (non-blocking).
SearchBar.js modal closes only on explicit close/ESC handler — verify no body scroll lock leak on rapid open/close (not observed in this test run but worth a quick check).

Firebase REACT_APP_FIREBASE_APP_ID in /app/frontend/.env is still `:android:` — Google/Phone login will fail in the Web SDK at runtime. This is known and documented (setup_instructions returned by /api/auth/firebase/status). Main agent / owner must create a Web App in Firebase Console and replace the appId before Google/Phone login works. Not a regression from this iteration; white-label path is correctly exposing the fix instructions.
